title: Capsaicin inhibits the biofilm of Klebsiella pneumoniae by targeting the transcriptional regulator SdiA.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究辣椒素通过靶向转录调控因子SdiA抑制肺炎克雷伯菌生物膜，含分子对接与MD模拟验证蛋白-配体复合物稳定性，但对象为细菌蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移但非TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Pneumonia, particularly when caused by the bacterium Klebsiella pneumoniae, presents a major global health challenge. This gram-negative bacterium is a notable pathogen in healthcare-associated infections, leading to severe conditions such as urinary tract infections, pneumonia, and the bloodstream infections, mainly in immunocompromised subjects. The bacterium's ability to resist multiple antibiotics complicates the treatment, posing a major concern in hospital settings. Capsaicin, one the major capsaiciniods present in Capsicum plants, is known for the bacteriostatic and bactericidal properties, though detailed studies on effects of capsaicin on biofilm in K. pneumoniae is not thoroughly investigated. Preliminary analyses indicate that capsaicin can inhibit the growth of K. pneumoniae at MIC (256 mug/ml). Capsaicin effectively inhibits biofilm development (72.65 +/- 3.23 %) and reduces the metabolic activity (46.64 +/- 4.31 %) of biofilms. Furthermore, exopolysaccharide production was diminished along with the eradication of established biofilm by capsaicin. Treatment of capsaicin decreased the cell surface hydrophobicity and induced the intracellular ROS production. The transcription level of biofilm and QS-related genes were also downregulated in presence of capsaicin. Computational analysis revealed that capsaicin interacts with transcriptional regulator SdiA with binding energy -5.6 kcal/mol. Molecular simulations validated the stability of SdiA-capsaicin complex under physiological conditions. The complex was mainly stabilized by the van der Waals forces. This study shows the potential of capsaicin in managing pneumonia complications, particularly those caused by K. pneumoniae. The findings suggest that capsaicin may serve as a promising agent in development of new therapeutic drug to combat bacterial infections associated with biofilm and antibiotic resistance.
abstract_zh: 肺炎，尤其是由肺炎克雷伯菌（Klebsiella pneumoniae）引起的肺炎，构成了全球重大健康挑战。这种革兰氏阴性菌是医疗相关感染中的重要病原体，主要导致免疫受损人群中的严重疾病，如尿路感染、肺炎和血流感染。该细菌对多种抗生素的耐药性使治疗复杂化，在医院环境中引起重大关注。辣椒素（capsaicin）是辣椒属（Capsicum）植物中主要辣椒素类物质之一，已知具有抑菌和杀菌特性，但关于辣椒素对肺炎克雷伯菌生物膜影响的详细研究尚未深入探讨。初步分析表明，辣椒素在最低抑菌浓度（MIC，256微克/毫升）下可抑制肺炎克雷伯菌的生长。辣椒素有效抑制生物膜发育（72.65 ± 3.23%），并降低生物膜的代谢活性（46.64 ± 4.31%）。此外，辣椒素还减少了胞外多糖的产生，并消除了已形成的生物膜。辣椒素处理降低了细胞表面疏水性，并诱导了细胞内活性氧（ROS）的产生。在辣椒素存在下，生物膜和群体感应（QS）相关基因的转录水平也下调。计算分析显示，辣椒素与转录调控因子SdiA相互作用，结合能为-5.6千卡/摩尔。分子模拟验证了SdiA-辣椒素复合物在生理条件下的稳定性。该复合物主要通过范德华力稳定。本研究展示了辣椒素在管理肺炎并发症（尤其是由肺炎克雷伯菌引起的并发症）方面的潜力。研究结果表明，辣椒素可能作为开发新型治疗药物的有前景候选物，以对抗与生物膜和抗生素耐药性相关的细菌感染。
